scenes.hook: JavaScript Objects. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Objects organize information as named properties and their values. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Use a property name to access one piece of an object.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw.
scenes.tip: Dot notation works with ordinary identifier-style property names. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Use bracket notation when a property name comes from a variable.
scenes.try: Create an object describing a learner and read its name. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
